Method of Attack: Adware campaign pushing full-screen advertisements after delay
Malicious code activates after delay (initially 30 minutes, later 24 hours)
Hides app icon to prevent easy uninstall
Ads show on entire screen when device unlocked and pop up at intervals
Communication with command and control server
Use of show count to control ad visibility duration
Tricks users with 'Open with' dialog to prevent closing ads
Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps distributed via Google Play and third-party Android app stores
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of 182 mobile apps with adware behavior
Apps with versions 1.0.0 to 1.0.2 initially with 30-minute delay
Later versions with 24-hour delay and C2 communication
Apps hidden from launcher to prevent uninstall
Full-screen ads that cannot be closed immediately
Apps removed from Google Play after discovery
